transcript: Speaker A (AI Avatar): Bade Salon Mein English Se Ghabara Gayi Kya? [Did you get scared of English in a big salon?] Speaker B (Human): Haan Yar, Haircut Ke Liye Aai Hun. Stylist Ne Aisi Fancy English Jhaadi Ki Main Blank Ho Goyi. [Yes friend, I came for a haircut. The stylist spoke such fancy English that I went blank.] Speaker A: Blank Mat Ho. SpeakEasy App Par Aao Aur Mere Sath Bindas English Bolo. [Don't go blank. Come to SpeakEasy App and speak English freely with me.] Speaker B: Par Madam Mujhe To Ye Nae Fashion Wali English Bolte Vakt Andar Se Dar Lagta Hai. [But Madam, I feel scared from inside while speaking this new-fashion English.] Speaker A: Darna Chhodo. Main AI Tutor Hun. Akele Mein Tumhari Desi Juban Ko Ekdam Smart Banaugi. [Stop fearing. I am an AI Tutor. In private, I will make your local tongue totally smart.] Speaker B: Baat To Dhamakedar Hai. Par College Aur Ghar Ke Kamon Ke Beech Time Kahan Hai? [That sounds amazing. But where is the time between college and household chores?] Speaker A: Kisne Bola Lambi Class? Din Ke Sirf 15 Minute Baat Karo Aur Trial Bhi Sirf ₹1 Mein. [Who said long classes? Speak for just 15 minutes a day, and trial is also for just ₹1.] Speaker B: ₹1 Mein? Phir To Agli Bar Parlor Wali Se Pure Tashan Mein Baat Karungi. [For ₹1? Then next time I will talk to the parlor lady with full attitude.] Speaker A: Apna Style Aur Confidence Dono Chamakao. SpeakEasy App Turant Download Karo. [Shine both your style and confidence. Download SpeakEasy App immediately.] Speaker C (Human Presenter): Abhi SpeakEasy App download karein aur farratedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download SpeakEasy App now and start speaking fluent English.]
